description: Four points wandering a square at random, each giving an X and a Y voltage

params.text: Sets how fast the points travel and how sharply they can turn, from 0.25 to 5 volts a second

outputs.text: Four channels carrying the horizontal position of the points, ±5V
Four channels carrying the vertical position of the points, ±5V

notes: both outputs always carry four channels, and the four points are independent of one another.
a point steers by a fresh random amount every 0.05 seconds, loses a tenth of its turning rate between steers, and reflects off the walls of the ±5V square.
a bounce also costs a point half its turning rate, so a point that hits a wall hard comes away straighter.
the points start from random positions when the module is added and keep moving whether or not anything reads them.
